title: Minimal free model over a local ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a local ring and let $K\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex], that is, isomorphic in $D(R)$ to a bounded-above complex of finite free $R$-modules. Put $d_i=\dim_\kappa H^i(K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}\kappa)$. If the $d_i$ are finite and vanish for all sufficiently large $i$, then $K$ is represented by a bounded-above complex of finite free $R$-modules whose term in degree $i$ is $R^{\oplus d_i}$. Such a complex is unique up to isomorphism of complexes.

proof.text: Construct explicitly the zero-differential residue complex $E^i=\operatorname{ULift}(\kappa^{d_i})$. The upper bound for $d_i$ makes it bounded above, and its terms are finite free. Apply [lem-sc-residue-cohomology-zero-complex] to the reduction of the chosen pseudo-coherent representative to obtain a quasi-isomorphism $E\to C_0\otimes\kappa$, and hence a derived isomorphism. No data is defined by choosing an arbitrary unproved existence witness.

The local maximal ideal satisfies the one-plus-ideal unit condition, by the Jacobson-ideal criterion. Apply [lem-sc-pseudo-coherent-lift-stably-free-complex] to $E$ and this ideal. It gives a bounded above finite free representative $P$ of $K$ whose reduction is isomorphic as a complex to $E$.

Evaluate the reduction isomorphism termwise, use Module.finrank_baseChange and the dimensions of the displayed free residue terms to obtain $\operatorname{finrank}_R P^i=d_i$. Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq and ULift.moduleEquiv give the required term isomorphisms $P^i\cong\operatorname{ULift}(R^{d_i})$ directly; transporting differentials is unnecessary.

For any competing model $G$, apply [lem-sc-minimal-free-comparison-residue] to obtain a comparison whose reduced components are isomorphisms. For each component use the Mathlib Nakayama consequence IsLocalRing.split_injective_iff_lTensor_residueField_injective: reduced injectivity gives a left inverse $g$; reduced surjectivity makes the reduction of $g$ injective; apply the same consequence to $g$ to make $g$ injective. The relation $gf=1$ now implies $fg=1$. Thus each component is an isomorphism, and HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components gives an isomorphism of complexes.

lean.statement: theorem exists_unique_minimalFreeModel {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (hK : IsPseudoCoherent K) (d : ℤ → ℕ) (hfinite : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars (IsLocalRing.residue R)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (Classical.choose hK)).homology i)) (hd : ∀ i : ℤ, d i = Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars (IsLocalRing.residue R)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (Classical.choose hK)).homology i)) (hbound : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → d i = 0) : ∃ F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ, (∃ b : ℤ, F.IsStrictlyLE b) ∧ Nonempty (Q.obj F ≅ K) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty (F.X i ≅ ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} (Fin (d i) → R)))) ∧ (∀ G : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ, (∃ b : ℤ, G.IsStrictlyLE b) → Nonempty (Q.obj G ≅ K) → (∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty (G.X i ≅ ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} (Fin (d i) → R)))) → Nonempty (F ≅ G))
